other_runtime.name: makepad-relax

anticipated_differences.noble: one immutable map pinned per root for all nested dispatch (S-LSLOT-01)

anticipated_differences.classification_rule: a Relax Refuse, Patch or Restart is admissible under the Relax profile and is an intentional semantic difference, never a Noble contract violation nor a Relax defect

anticipated_differences.noble: a root started before a publication keeps its pinned version
anticipated_differences.relax: a Patch may take effect in already-created state; whether an active call keeps the old code is a Relax-profile question that must be declared before measuring it
anticipated_differences.classification_rule: a difference here is recorded as intentional until the Relax profile is frozen and quoted

scenarios.title: Shared saved owners, composition ownership and a cross-module alias

bounded.statement: Five sessions: two release orders for two owners, one balanced 8-leaf compose tree, one left-deep chain to its refusal, one cross-module duplicate

normal.purpose: each duplicate runs the same Program

abnormal.subject: ownership.released-owner
abnormal.reason: a released owner is refused, not trapped

origin.text: the remaining owner runs after the first release; both are refused after the second

origin.text: results are equal and no leaf is freed while the root lives

expectations.mapping: every non-root owner is released before the root is run again; the result must not change

origin.text: the host observation of an anonymous saved Program is bounded; a left-deep fifth compose is refused as a guest failure

expectations.mapping: the refusal is a declared bound, not a defect: the session terminates as every failed root does

origin.text: a duplicate made by a second module gets its own owner and releases independently

expectations.mapping: the original and the two duplicates are distinct owners; each runs the original Program

comparison.faithful_mapping: each saved Program owns its package: a released owner is refused and the surviving owners keep running, in both release orders and across a module alias
unsupported_dimensions: owner tokens surviving a host process restart

other_runtime.name: makepad-relax
other_runtime.reason: compiler-lab #188 (Relax host), #189 (temporal admission) and #190 (persistent sessions) are not available; no Relax profile is frozen, so the Relax column is not-run

anticipated_differences.noble: each saved Program owns its package through an explicit host owner token
anticipated_differences.relax: retained code is owned by the reload transaction, not by a saved value
anticipated_differences.classification_rule: owner-token differences are an intentional semantic difference; a double free or a stale handle is a failure in either runtime
